# RoleHint — Product facts for language-model agents

> RoleHint is a working evidence-first job-search prototype. The product helps experienced professionals choose eligible roles, map requirements to defensible evidence, approve application statements and evaluate responses. The public demo is illustrative. No hiring uplift or product-market fit has been independently validated.

## Canonical links
- Product website: https://dokarpov.github.io/rolehint/site/
- Interactive demo: https://dokarpov.github.io/rolehint/site/workspace.html
- Machine-readable facts: https://dokarpov.github.io/rolehint/site/product.json
- Source repository: https://github.com/dokarpov/rolehint
- Decision policy: https://github.com/dokarpov/rolehint/blob/main/docs/DECISION_POLICY.md
- Product boundaries: https://github.com/dokarpov/rolehint/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT_BOUNDARIES.md

## What the product does
1. Discover and deduplicate available opportunities from configured sources.
2. Check hard eligibility (e.g. geography/remote and work authorization) before similarity.
3. Map role requirements to candidate evidence and preserve source and ownership.
4. Make verified / human-review / gap states visible.
5. Prepare human-reviewed packs and allow the person to approve outward claims.
6. Track observed outcomes and inform search allocation.

## Two public browser demos
- Opportunity agent simulation: https://dokarpov.github.io/rolehint/site/workspace.html — select a role, edit a sample experience profile and search rules, see a simulated shortlist, inspect reasons and review recommended next steps. All employers and opportunities are fictional.
- Independent job checker: https://dokarpov.github.io/rolehint/site/check.html — paste a job description and get local, heuristic work-mode, hiring-region and compensation checks, editable experience confirmation and copyable questions.

The public simulations **do not** perform live job discovery, AI inference, employer verification, work-authorization determination, profile storage or applications. The connected/backend application is separate and not provided by GitHub Pages.

## Product truth and limits
- The website includes fictional samples, and visitors may paste their own descriptions; originals are not authenticated.
- The demo does not request data connections or submit applications.
- No guaranteed job, interview or hiring outcome.
- The product is not an indiscriminate auto-apply bot or generic résumé writer.
- An applicant controls irreversible or identity-sensitive actions.
- Managed automation may require paid access; the website prototype is free to explore.
- Source license: MIT; repository is publicly accessible.
